**Time Complexity:** Spatial transform is $O(W \cdot H \cdot D)$.
Temporal prediction is $O(W \cdot H \cdot D)$ for simple difference or $O(W \cdot H \cdot D \cdot M)$ for motion estimation with search range $M$.
**Strengths:** High compression ratios for volumes with strong inter-slice correlation (e.g., medical imaging, time-varying data).
**Limitations:** Less effective for volumes with weak inter-slice correlation.
